## 2) Labor-Datensatz einlesen & aufbereiten

```{r}
#| label: load-labor

kaefer <- read.csv2(paste0(path_labor, "/New_Species_Database.Perc.csv"), sep = ";")
kaefer <- kaefer %>% relocate(c(OTU_ID, cluster_size), .before = NCBI_Accession_ID)

assign_taxonomy <- function(row) {
  dbs <- c("RDP/UNITE", "BOLD", "NCBI")
  for (db in dbs) {
    if (db == "RDP/UNITE") {
      percent_identity <- as.numeric(row$RDP_Species_Support)
      grade <- 1
      species <- row$RDP_Species; genus <- row$RDP_Genus
      family <- row$RDP_Family;   order <- row$RDP_Order
      class <- row$RDP_Class;     phylum <- row$RDP_Phylum
      kingdom <- row$RDP_Kingdom
    } else if (db == "BOLD") {
      percent_identity <- as.numeric(row$BOLD_HIT.ID)
      grade <- as.numeric(row$BOLD_Grade.ID)
      species <- row$BOLD_Species; genus <- row$BOLD_Genus
      family <- row$BOLD_Family;   order <- row$BOLD_Order
      class <- row$BOLD_Class;     phylum <- row$BOLD_Phylum
      kingdom <- "Fungi"
    } else if (db == "NCBI") {
      percent_identity <- as.numeric(row$NCBI_HIT.ID)
      grade <- as.numeric(row$NCBI_Grade.ID)
      species <- row$NCBI_Species; genus <- row$NCBI_Genus
      family <- row$NCBI_Family;   order <- row$NCBI_Order
      class <- row$NCBI_Class;     phylum <- row$NCBI_Phylum
      kingdom <- "Fungi"
    } else { next }

    if (!is.na(percent_identity) && percent_identity >= 0.975 && grade > 0.7)
      return(c(row$OTU_ID, percent_identity, grade, db,
               kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species))
    if (!is.na(percent_identity) && percent_identity >= 0.95 &&
        percent_identity < 0.975 && grade > 0.7)
      return(c(row$OTU_ID, percent_identity, grade, db,
               kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, ""))
  }
  return(c(row$OTU_ID, NA, NA, "No match", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""))
}

df_cons <- as.data.frame(t(apply(kaefer, 1, function(r) assign_taxonomy(as.list(r)))))
colnames(df_cons) <- c("OTU_ID", "Percent_identity", "Grade", "db",
                       "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "GENUS", "Species")
df_cons <- df_cons %>% filter(Kingdom == "Fungi")

SingleReads <- read.csv2(paste0(path_labor, "/New_Sum_reads_per_Species.csv"),
                         sep = ";", skip = 2)
SingleReads$sum_reads_per_OTU <- as.numeric(SingleReads$sum_reads_per_OTU)
Reads <- merge(df_cons, SingleReads, by = "OTU_ID")

beetle_cols_labor <- colnames(Reads)[14:ncol(Reads)]

cat("Labor-Datensatz:\n")
cat("  OTUs (Fungi):   ", nrow(Reads), "\n")
cat("  Proben-Spalten: ", length(beetle_cols_labor), "\n")
cat("  Gesamt-Reads:   ", sum(SingleReads$sum_reads_per_OTU, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## 3) DADA2-Datensatz einlesen

```{r}
#| label: load-dada2

# Nur gemeinsame Arten in ps
shared_species_underscore <- gsub(" ", "_", shared_species)

ps_shared <- subset_samples(ps, beetle_species %in% shared_species_underscore)

cat("DADA2 - nur gemeinsame Arten:\n")
cat("  Proben:       ", nsamples(ps_shared), "\n")
cat("  Gesamt-Reads: ", sum(sample_sums(ps_shared)), "\n")

# Labor - nur gemeinsame Arten
reads_labor_shared <- sum(reads_compare$reads_labor)
cat("\nLabor - nur gemeinsame Arten:\n")
cat("  Gesamt-Reads: ", reads_labor_shared, "\n")

cat("\nVerhältnis DADA2/Labor Reads:", 
    round(sum(sample_sums(ps_shared)) / reads_labor_shared, 2), "\n")
```

---

## 4) Vergleich: Reads pro Käferart

```{r}
#| label: compare-reads

# Labor
reads_labor_long <- Reads %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(beetle_cols_labor),
               names_to = "sample", values_to = "reads") %>%
  mutate(
    reads = as.numeric(reads),
    # Punkte → Unterstriche, dann Nummer am Ende entfernen
    beetle_species = gsub("\\.", "_", sample),
    beetle_species = gsub("_\\d+$", "", beetle_species),
    # abgewaschen_Ips → Ips_typographus
    beetle_species = gsub("^abgewaschen_Ips$", "Ips_typographus", beetle_species),
    beetle_species = gsub("^abgewaschen_Stenurella_melanura$", 
                          "Stenurella_melanura", beetle_species),
    # Unterstriche → Leerzeichen für Konsistenz mit DADA2
    beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(reads), reads > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(beetle_species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(reads_labor = sum(reads), .groups = "drop")

unique(reads_labor_long$beetle_species)

# DADA2
reads_dada2_long <- data.frame(
  sample      = sample_names(ps),
  reads_dada2 = sample_sums(ps)
) %>%
  left_join(meta_df[, c("sample", "beetle_species")], by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(beetle_species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(reads_dada2 = sum(reads_dada2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species))

unique(reads_dada2_long$beetle_species)

# Plot
# Nur Arten die in BEIDEN Datensätzen vorkommen
shared_species <- intersect(
  reads_labor_long$beetle_species,
  reads_dada2_long$beetle_species
)

cat("Arten in Labor:", nrow(reads_labor_long), "\n")
cat("Arten in DADA2:", nrow(reads_dada2_long), "\n")
cat("Gemeinsame Arten:", length(shared_species), "\n")# Nur 6, weil in DADA2 Grammoptera fehlt

reads_compare <- inner_join(reads_labor_long, reads_dada2_long,
                             by = "beetle_species")

cat("Gemeinsame Arten:", nrow(reads_compare), "\n")
print(reads_compare)

# Plot
reads_compare %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(reads_labor, reads_dada2),
               names_to = "pipeline", values_to = "reads") %>%
  mutate(pipeline = recode(pipeline,
                           "reads_labor" = "Labor",
                           "reads_dada2" = "DADA2")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = beetle_species, y = reads, fill = pipeline)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Labor" = "#D94801", "DADA2" = "#2171B5")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total reads", fill = "Pipeline",
       title = "Reads pro Käferart: Labor vs. DADA2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```

## 5) Vergleich: Anzahl OTUs/ASVs pro Käferart

```{r}
#| label: compare-richness

# ── Labor: OTUs pro Art ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
otus_labor <- Reads %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(beetle_cols_labor),
               names_to = "sample", values_to = "reads") %>%
  mutate(
    reads = as.numeric(reads),
    beetle_species = gsub("\\.", "_", sample),
    beetle_species = gsub("_\\d+$", "", beetle_species),
    beetle_species = gsub("^abgewaschen_Ips$", "Ips_typographus", beetle_species),
    beetle_species = gsub("^abgewaschen_Stenurella_melanura$",
                          "Stenurella_melanura", beetle_species),
    beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(reads), reads > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(beetle_species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(otus_labor = n_distinct(OTU_ID), .groups = "drop")

# ── DADA2: ASVs pro Art ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
otu_mat <- as.matrix(t(otu_table(ps)))
colnames(otu_mat) <- gsub("^X", "", colnames(otu_mat))

asvs_dada2 <- data.frame(
  sample     = rownames(otu_mat),
  asvs_dada2 = rowSums(otu_mat > 0)
) %>%
  left_join(meta_df[, c("sample", "beetle_species")], by = "sample") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(beetle_species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(asvs_dada2 = sum(asvs_dada2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species))

# ── Nur gemeinsame Arten ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
otus_compare <- inner_join(otus_labor, asvs_dada2, by = "beetle_species")

# Plot
otus_compare %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(otus_labor, asvs_dada2),
               names_to = "pipeline", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(pipeline = recode(pipeline,
                           "otus_labor" = "Labor (OTUs)",
                           "asvs_dada2" = "DADA2 (ASVs)")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = beetle_species, y = n, fill = pipeline)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Labor (OTUs)" = "#D94801",
                                "DADA2 (ASVs)" = "#2171B5")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Anzahl OTUs/ASVs", fill = "Pipeline",
       title = "OTU/ASV-Anzahl pro Käferart: Labor vs. DADA2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```
```{r}
# Wie viele Proben pro Art im Labor?
Reads %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(beetle_cols_labor),
               names_to = "sample", values_to = "reads") %>%
  mutate(
    reads = as.numeric(reads),
    beetle_species = gsub("\\.", "_", sample),
    beetle_species = gsub("_\\d+$", "", beetle_species),
    beetle_species = gsub("^abgewaschen_Ips$", "Ips_typographus", beetle_species),
    beetle_species = gsub("^abgewaschen_Stenurella_melanura$",

reads_labor_per_sample <- Reads %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(beetle_cols_labor),
               names_to = "sample", values_to = "reads") %>%
  mutate(
    reads = as.numeric(reads),
    beetle_species = gsub("\\.", "_", sample),
    beetle_species = gsub("_\\d+$", "", beetle_species),
    beetle_species = gsub("^abgewaschen_Ips$", "Ips_typographus", beetle_species),
    beetle_species = gsub("^abgewaschen_Stenurella_melanura$",
                          "Stenurella_melanura", beetle_species),
    beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(beetle_species %in% shared_species) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(reads_labor = sum(reads, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

cat("Mittlere Reads pro Probe (Labor):", 
    round(mean(reads_labor_per_sample$reads_labor), 0), "\n")
cat("Mittlere Reads pro Probe (DADA2):", 
    round(mean(sample_sums(ps_shared)), 0), "\n")
```
## OTU-Vergleich

```{r}

uc <- read.table(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/otus.uc"),
                 sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Nur Hit-Zeilen (H) und Seed-Zeilen (S) behalten
uc_hits <- uc[uc$V1 %in% c("H", "S"), c("V1", "V9", "V10")]
colnames(uc_hits) <- c("type", "asv", "otu")

# Size-Tag entfernen
uc_hits$asv_clean <- gsub(";size=.*$", "", uc_hits$asv)
uc_hits$otu_clean <- gsub(";size=.*$", "", uc_hits$otu)

# Für S-Zeilen (Seeds) ist OTU = ASV
uc_hits$otu_clean[uc_hits$type == "S"] <- uc_hits$asv_clean[uc_hits$type == "S"]

cat("ASVs gemappt:", nrow(uc_hits), "\n")
cat("OTUs gesamt:", length(unique(uc_hits$otu_clean)), "\n")

# ── Schritt 2: OTU-Tabelle erstellen ──────────────────────────────────────────
# ASV-Matrix aus phyloseq (Samples × ASVs)
asv_mat <- as.matrix(t(otu_table(ps)))
colnames(asv_mat) <- gsub("^X", "", colnames(asv_mat))

# Mapping: Sequenz → OTU-Centroid
asv_to_otu <- setNames(uc_hits$otu_clean, uc_hits$asv_clean)

# Nur gematchte ASVs
shared <- intersect(colnames(asv_mat), names(asv_to_otu))
cat("Matches:", length(shared), "\n") #10833

# OTU-Tabelle durch Summierung
otu_mat_new <- t(rowsum(t(asv_mat[, shared]),
                         group = asv_to_otu[shared],
                         na.rm = TRUE))

cat("OTU-Tabelle:", nrow(otu_mat_new), "Samples ×", ncol(otu_mat_new), "OTUs\n")


# OTUs pro Art in DADA2 (nach VSEARCH clustering)
otus_dada2 <- data.frame(
  sample     = rownames(otu_mat_new),
  otus_dada2 = rowSums(otu_mat_new > 0)
) %>%
  left_join(meta_df[, c("sample", "beetle_species")], by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = gsub("_", " ", beetle_species)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(beetle_species %in% shared_species) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(beetle_species) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(otus_dada2 = sum(otus_dada2), .groups = "drop")

# ── Vergleich ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
otus_compare <- inner_join(otus_labor, otus_dada2, by = "beetle_species")

print(otus_compare)

# Plot
otus_compare %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(otus_labor, otus_dada2),
               names_to = "pipeline", values_to = "n") %>%
  mutate(pipeline = recode(pipeline,
                           "otus_labor" = "Labor",
                           "otus_dada2" = "DADA2 (VSEARCH)")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = beetle_species, y = n, fill = pipeline)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Labor" = "#D94801",
                                "DADA2 (VSEARCH)" = "#2171B5")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of OTUs", fill = "Pipeline",
       title = "OTU-Anzahl pro Käferart: Labor vs. DADA2+VSEARCH") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"))
```

```{r}
otus_compare %>%
  left_join(reads_compare, by = "beetle_species") %>%
  mutate(
    reads_per_otu_labor = round(reads_labor / otus_labor, 1),
    reads_per_otu_dada2 = round(reads_dada2 / otus_dada2, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(beetle_species, reads_per_otu_labor, reads_per_otu_dada2)
```

## 6) Übersichtstabelle

```{r}
#| label: summary-table

summary_table <- inner_join(reads_labor_long, reads_dada2_long, by = "beetle_species") %>%
  inner_join(otus_labor,  by = "beetle_species") %>%
  inner_join(otus_dada2,  by = "beetle_species") %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_reads = round(reads_dada2 / reads_labor, 2),
    ratio_otus  = round(otus_dada2  / otus_labor,  2)
  )

knitr::kable(summary_table,
             col.names = c("Beetle species", "Reads (Labor)", "Reads (DADA2)",
                           "OTUs (Labor)", "OTUs (DADA2+VSEARCH)",
                           "Reads ratio", "OTU ratio"),
             caption = "Vergleich Labor-Pipeline vs. DADA2+VSEARCH-Pipeline pro Käferart")
```
